nodes.name: options.nix
nodes.summary: Host options file for the 'workbox' machine; sets the custom my.host.isLaptop flag to true.

nodes.name: pipewire.nix
nodes.summary: Reusable NixOS module enabling PipeWire audio with ALSA (including 32-bit) and PulseAudio compatibility layers.

nodes.name: smb.nix
nodes.summary: NixOS module mounting a CIFS/SMB share from an OpenMediaVault server to ~/Tank with systemd automount and credential-file options.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a let-binding to compose systemd automount mount options for a lazy-mounted network share.

nodes.name: zram.nix
nodes.summary: NixOS module enabling zram swap with lz4 compression, high priority, and a 50% memory cap.

nodes.name: networkmanager.nix
nodes.summary: NixOS module enabling NetworkManager and installing the networkmanagerapplet tray utility.

nodes.name: tailscale.nix
nodes.summary: NixOS module configuring Tailscale VPN: trusts the tailscale0 interface, forces nftables firewall mode, and disables systemd network wait-online for faster boot.

nodes.name: zsh.nix
nodes.summary: NixOS module enabling zsh system-wide and setting it as the default user shell.

nodes.name: lanzaboote.nix
nodes.summary: NixOS module enabling Secure Boot via the lanzaboote flake input, using /var/lib/sbctl as the PKI bundle and force-disabling systemd-boot.
nodes.languageNotes: Imports a NixOS module from a flake input and uses lib.mkForce to override systemd-boot.

nodes.name: locals.nix
nodes.summary: NixOS module setting the Europe/Berlin timezone, en_US default locale, and de_DE formats for all LC_* locale categories.

nodes.name: systemd-boot.nix
nodes.summary: NixOS module enabling the systemd-boot bootloader with a 3-generation configuration limit and EFI variable access.

nodes.name: virtmanager.nix
nodes.summary: NixOS module enabling libvirtd and virt-manager, with dnsmasq installed for VM NAT networking.

nodes.name: dwm.nix
nodes.summary: Empty placeholder NixOS module reserved for future dwm window manager configuration.

nodes.name: hyprland.nix
nodes.summary: NixOS module enabling the Hyprland Wayland compositor system-wide with XWayland support.

nodes.name: mango.nix
nodes.summary: NixOS module enabling the Mango (mangowc) Wayland compositor using the pkgs.mango package.

nodes.name: tmux-sessionizer
nodes.summary: fzf-based tmux session switcher (fork of ThePrimeagen's script) that searches configurable directory paths, creates/attaches sessions, and supports scripted session commands in numbered windows or persistent splits.
nodes.languageNotes: Bash script with no file extension; supports XDG config overrides, per-path search depth suffixes, and a pane-ID cache for split session commands.

nodes.name: update
nodes.summary: Bash wrapper around 'nh os switch' that fetches origin/main, refuses to switch when the local repo is behind, and prompts to commit and push post-switch changes such as flake.lock updates.

nodes.name: sanity_check
nodes.summary: Verifies that tmux and fzf are installed, exiting with an error message if either is missing.

nodes.name: hydrate
nodes.summary: Sends a source command into a newly created tmux session, preferring a per-directory .tmux-sessionizer file over the global one in $HOME.

nodes.name: set_pane_id
nodes.summary: Records a session-index/split-type to tmux pane-ID mapping in the pane cache file, replacing any existing entry.

nodes.name: cleanup_dead_panes
nodes.summary: Prunes pane-cache entries whose tmux pane IDs no longer exist by cross-checking against tmux list-panes.

nodes.name: find_dirs
nodes.summary: Builds the fzf candidate list: existing tmux sessions (excluding the current one) plus directories found under TS_SEARCH_PATHS with per-path or default max depth.

nodes.name: handle_session_cmd
nodes.summary: Dispatches a configured TS_SESSION_COMMANDS entry to either a split-pane or numbered-window handler, requiring a running tmux server.

nodes.name: handle_window_session_cmd
nodes.summary: Runs a session command in a dedicated tmux window at index 69+N, creating and hydrating the window if it does not already exist.

nodes.name: handle_split_session_cmd
nodes.summary: Runs a session command in a persistent vertical or horizontal tmux split, reusing a cached pane when one still exists and caching new pane IDs otherwise.

nodes.name: show_help
nodes.summary: Prints usage, options, environment variables, and examples for the update script.
